FC WIT Georgia is a Georgian football team from Tbilisi. The team is sponsored by WIT Georgia Ltd, a pet food, accessories, and human and veterinary pharmaceuticals import company. WIT stands for World Innovation Technologies. They play their home games at Mikheil Meskhi Stadium in Tbilisi.
